title: Chest pain
plain: Chest pain or pressure can be the heart. Aspirin and rest, unless you have stroke signs.

doNotGive.reason: Ibuprofen can make heart damage worse

steps.question: Do you have face drooping, arm weakness or slurred speech?

steps.detail: It thins the blood and can limit damage if this is the heart.

steps.text: Don't take aspirin: with stroke signs it can make a bleed worse
Stop everything. Sit or lie down, loosen tight clothing and breathe slowly.
Measure your oxygen. Below 94%: put on oxygen.
Rest for the rest of the day. If the pain comes back, press Help now again.

escalation: Pain lasting more than 20 minutes, fainting or trouble breathing: put on oxygen and follow EMG-CHEST-PAIN. The crew and Earth were alerted when you started.
